svg.title: Tidal Lagoon — Three-stair tide gauge
svg.desc: An open basin sits below a permanent ring boardwalk. Three tide stairs reach lower sample platforms; the gauge tower and ferry shed make the upper loop. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops
